purpose: Simplified portrait homepage concept; image only
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Revise the reference “Facta, non verba” homepage concept into a MUCH SIMPLER TALL PORTRAIT landing page. Reference image is the existing design to simplify, preserving its identity, type style, botanical character, and palette. The user explicitly wants a vertical image, a clear labour-marketplace message, strong cryptographic controls, and a primary action directing visitors to the source code.

Final image must be a fully opaque, flat, straight-on webpage screenshot in PORTRAIT orientation, approximately 1024 pixels wide by 1536 pixels tall, height greater than width. Render a solid warm ivory #F6F2E8 full-page background, edge to edge. Every pixel is opaque, alpha255: no transparent areas, checkerboards, cutouts, black empty background, device frame, or photography of a screen. Do not remove the background after generation.

Visual design: quiet, sparse, refined editorial website; generous vertical whitespace; forest-black typography #242C24, moss green #526A48, cream/tan and terracotta from the brand illustration. Large elegant serif headline with italic green second line, simple sans-serif supporting copy. A centered single-column layout with consistent margins. A single modest thin horizontal rule near the footer. No cards, grids, ornamental interface clutter or drop shadows.

Use only these main elements in this order:
1. At the very top, a small green sprout emblem and restrained lowercase wordmark “facta, non verba”. NO navigation menu.
2. Large two-line centered headline exactly:
“Facta,
non verba.”
Keep the first line dark forest ink and the second line moss-green italic serif.
3. Prominent, easily readable descriptive statement below the headline, exactly:
“A marketplace for labour,
with strong cryptographic controls.”
It must be obvious at first glance that this is a marketplace for labour; “labour” uses British spelling. Supporting copy in smaller type, exactly:
“Signed offers. Tamper-evident records.”
4. One centered medium-large botanical brand character, taking roughly the middle third to two-fifths of the page height: faceless cream-robed figure with thick near-black outlines, tied rope belt, reddish brown closed book in viewer-left hand, and a two-leaf green sprout in viewer-right hand. Faithfully match the reference character's simple watercolor texture, proportions, blank oval face, robe and objects. A very restrained pale sage circular field may sit behind the figure. No extra foliage or surrounding landscape.
5. Below the illustration, ONE prominent forest-green button with light text exactly “View source on GitHub ↗”. This is the sole primary action; use no demo button, no sign-up, no secondary CTA. Beneath it a smaller clearly legible source address, exactly:
“github.com/savethebeesandseeds/non-verba”
6. A subtle small footer: “Open source · In development”.

Remove the original example-workflow card, horizontal four-step strip, bottom landscape and participation section, navigation links, extra buttons and explanatory paragraphs. Do not introduce any new sections. No payment totals, fake adoption statistics, wallets, cryptocurrency imagery, padlock clipart, fake security seals, or claims that signatures prove physical truth. All requested words must be spelled accurately and fit with comfortable margins. The result should feel like a purposeful, elegant, minimal landing page whose job is to explain the project and send people to its public source.
